code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia, metabolic acidosis (very low pH, low CO₂), and low oxygen saturation, with anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer, INR). There is also mild hypoalbuminemia and hypoproteinemia. These findings suggest a severe systemic inflammatory response, possibly sepsis or severe infection, with multi-organ involvement and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
